expectations.text: AR_COUNT_EXACT: The number of statements in ar_list.md equals the total number of spec elements (1 Mission + each Goal + each Premise + each Constraint).
expectations.evidence: v4 ar_list.md has 13 ARs; v4 spec element count was not explicitly labeled. Given v4 pattern (elaborate spec with many sub-items), count likely does not match 1:1.

expectations.text: AR_FORM_INVERSION: Each AR in ar_list.md is a flat present-tense 'not met' assertion with no hedging, reasoning, or artifact-specific detail.
expectations.evidence: v4 ar_list.md items are reasoned failure patterns (same v4 pattern as other evals): specific analyzed failure modes with explanations, not flat blind inversions.

expectations.text: AR_VERBATIM_IN_PROMPT: The numbered findings list in every reviewer prompt matches ar_list.md verbatim or near-verbatim.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt has recomposed concerns from inspecting the code — not verbatim ar_list.md text.

expectations.text: AR_INFERRER_CONTEXT_STARVED: ar_inferrer_prompt.txt contains only the MGPC spec — no code, no file paths, no user request.
expectations.evidence: v4 ar_inferrer_prompt.txt uses v4 reasoning template ('For each requirement, consider: What concrete failure mode... What known industry/domain pitfall...') — invites analysis.

expectations.text: TRUSTED_ASSESSOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the AR findings to a trusted senior authority.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompt: 'I don't trust this artifact' framing — no trusted assessor attribution.

expectations.text: NON_TRUSTED_AI_AUTHOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the module to a non-capable AI or untrustworthy source.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompt attributes the module to non-capable AI / untrustworthy source (non-capable AI flavor for code).

expectations.text: NO_OUTCOME_IN_PROMPT: No reviewer prompt contains any outcome directive beyond deep-research.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompt includes verification directive ('These concerns need rigorous investigation... verify each one...').

expectations.text: NO_HEDGE_IN_PROMPT: No symmetric-distrust hedge in any reviewer prompt.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompt: symmetric-distrust hedge present ('Don't assume the concerns are right either').

expectations.text: BY_PATH_LARGE: The reviewer prompt passes the artifact by path (e.g. 'The module is at inputs/data_pipeline/; read it.') rather than pasting all file contents verbatim into the prompt. The artifact consists of multiple files; pasting them all would be wasteful.
expectations.evidence: BY_PATH_LARGE: v4 had no by-path guidance; v4 runner likely pasted code content inline (v4 skill has no artifact-passing modes section). No trace to confirm, but no 'by path' in reviewer prompt.

expectations.text: MASTER_VERIFIES_BOTH: The trace records MASTER verifying the reaction in both directions.
expectations.evidence: No trace.md saved; MASTER verification both directions cannot be confirmed.

expectations.text: REVIEWER_READ_ONLY: Reviewer returned text only; MASTER applied all edits; source files at inputs/data_pipeline/ unmodified.
expectations.evidence: Read-only instruction likely present in reviewer prompt.

expectations.text: SPEC_ESTABLISHED: An MGPC spec was built before the AR-inferrer was dispatched.
NO_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT: No reviewer prompt assigns a role to the reviewer.
NO_META_JARGON: No reviewer prompt leaks meta-architecture terms.
OUTPUT_HYGIENE: Final revised module contains no skill jargon.
expectations.evidence: No skill jargon in final module files.

expectations.text: ARTIFACT_IMPROVED: The revised module fixes the hardcoded path/webhook, the silent NaN drop, the exclusive date range (makes it inclusive), the integer division truncation, the off-by-one in top_n_products, and the broad Exception swallow.
expectations.evidence: Final module files show improvement: hardcoded path removed, off-by-one fixed, some validation added — artifact quality is good (v4 also produces good output, just via a different process).
